facts.fact: bake settings: bake type is scene.cycles.bake_type (the op's type= overrides it); margin and other options are on scene.render.bake; defaults

bpy.ops.object.bake raises RuntimeError when the mesh has no UV map ('No active UV layer found') or the engine is not Cycles ('Current render engine does not support baking'); with no Image Texture node in the material it does not raise: it returns {'CANCELLED'} and bakes nothing, so check the return value

errors.no UV map: Error: No active UV layer found in the object "Plane"
errors.engine EEVEE: Error: Current render engine does not support baking

facts.fact: DIFFUSE with pass_filter={'COLOR'} writes the diffuse albedo alone, linear, in a float image: Base Color (0.8, 0.2, 0.1) bakes as about 0.96 of itself, because the Principled specular layer takes its share; with Specular IOR Level 0 it bakes as the Base Color itself
DIFFUSE with DIRECT+INDIRECT+COLOR bakes lighting in: the texel under the cube is darker than an open one
NORMAL (tangent space, the default) of a flat face is (0.5, 0.5, 1.0)
AO is 1 on open floor and darker next to the cube
bake times on Metal at 128 px, 32 samples
a baked image lives only in memory (is_dirty True) until it is saved: set filepath_raw and file_format, then image.save()
image.save() wrote the bake to disk
